blocks.text: LIMA — Pope Leo XIV arrived in his “beloved” Peru on Wednesday, a nostalgic return to the nation where he spent two decades as a missionary before being tapped to lead the world’s 1.4 billion Catholics. The 71-year-old pontiff landed in Lima on the last leg of an arduous three-nation Latin American tour, just weeks after undergoing surgery for lung cancer. “The pope is Peruvian!” exclaimed some of the estimated three million supporters who lined the streets along the route from the airport, as phalanxes of soldiers in red and green berets stood guard.
